description: Per-token 8-bit GEMM: out = (a * a_scale) @ (b * b_scale).T + bias with a_scale per row of a and b_scale per output column; int8 or fp8 operands. aiter gemm_a8w8 / gemm_a8w8_bpreshuffle, hipBLASLt scaled GEMM, Triton per-token FP8.

hooks.preshuffle_16x16: (t, name, sym) -> aiter shuffle_weight(t, layout=(16, 16)) with t.is_shuffled = True.

call: Pass a, b, a_scale, b_scale (bias) as the live caller does; a_scale/b_scale may be squeezed to 1-D by the caller — match it. Return out.

timing.cache: b/b_scale weights (cold), a/a_scale from the preceding quant (warm in serving).

negative_controls: apply a_scale of row r+1 to row r: wrong per-row magnitude
drop the bias add when has_bias
pitfalls: int8 operands accumulate exactly in int32: an int8 task may tighten the bound to output_rounding (override with why) because every correct kernel produces the same integers before scaling.
Integer draws: normal std 1 cast to int8 is mostly {-2..2}; for int8 override a with uniform [-127, 127] so the accumulation reaches realistic magnitudes.
